preprocessing: OneHotEncoder on source, passthrough on boolean features
metrics_note: Metrics were computed by evaluating the shipped junk_classifier.joblib against crm.db with reconstructed features (has_quiz_answers / matched_at_intake derived heuristically). train/test are an 80/20 stratified split (random_state=42) of the current data used only for evaluation, not the model's original training split.
